prefeito.comoAssumiu: Presidente da Câmara Municipal, assumiu a prefeitura de forma interina em 11/09/2026, com a assinatura da ata de posse, depois que a Justiça Eleitoral cassou os mandatos do prefeito Luciano Pinto da Silva e do vice eleitos em 2024. Na eleição suplementar de 25/10/2026, foram eleitos Felipe Valim (MDB), prefeito, e Alemão do Mercado (PSDB), vice; eles tomam posse depois da diplomação pela Justiça Eleitoral.
prefeito.comoAssumiu_en: As president of the City Council, she became acting mayor on September 11, 2026, when the record of her swearing-in was signed, after the Electoral Courts revoked the terms of Mayor Luciano Pinto da Silva and the vice mayor elected in 2024. In the special election held on October 25, 2026, Felipe Valim (MDB) was elected mayor and Alemão do Mercado (PSDB) vice mayor; they take office after being certified by the Electoral Courts.

vice.txt: O cargo de vice-prefeito está vago desde setembro de 2026, quando a Justiça Eleitoral afastou o prefeito e o vice eleitos em 2024. Alemão do Mercado (PSDB), eleito vice-prefeito na eleição suplementar de 25/10/2026, toma posse junto com o prefeito eleito.
vice.txt_en: The office of vice mayor has been vacant since September 2026, when the Electoral Courts removed the mayor and vice mayor elected in 2024. Alemão do Mercado (PSDB), elected vice mayor in the special election held on October 25, 2026, takes office together with the mayor-elect.

aviso_en: Who is in office today was checked by hand, using the sources shown. The winners of the special election held on October 25, 2026 take office after being certified by the Electoral Courts; until then, the city is run by the person shown below, checked by hand on October 29, 2026.
